analyst.summary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals has a genuinely exciting multi-year growth story across fluoropolymers, the new R32 refrigerant gas line, and battery chemicals (a beneficiary of US supply-chain diversification away from China), and margins are expanding nicely. The concern is entirely about price: at roughly 79 times earnings against a 12% return on equity, the market is already paying for several years of successful execution across three separate new businesses at once. We would treat the current price as a trim opportunity, not an add.
